name: Tiangong 1
about: Tiangong 1 (2011-053A), a station core, launched 2011 Sep 29. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2011 Oct  6), held fixed
